compact_projection.scope: One discontinuous-field model and exterior harmonic modes; not the general projection existence proof.

harmonic_interaction.scope: Exact harmonic example and amplitude-polynomial implication; no absolute minimizer constructed.

green_regularization.scope: Numerical finite matrices; not all disk configurations or the continuum resolvent limit.

reciprocal_updates.scope: Finite inertia, Schur series and Hilbert-distance models; no boundary Green-kernel limit.

localized_virial.scope: Algebra and finite nonsingular kernel sums; not integrability, existence or nonexistence of PDE solutions.

interval_comparison.scope: Bounded separated intervals by quadrature; unbounded zero-weight cases follow the written nonnegative argument.

splitting_obstruction.scope: Exact finite copies of the mass obstruction; no Coulomb dual support certificate checked.

cell_mass_approximation.scope: Exact block marginals and separated-cost samples; interval models are not three-dimensional density constructions or an attainment proof.

limitations: Selected finite mechanisms only. No global regularity, hot-spots, nonexistence or Coulomb counterexample proof is certified; no Lean build.
